features.quote: you can't interpret 'distressed-sounding text' as-is … a high severity score is uninterpretable
features.justification_quote: you'd get a methodologically weak study … measured 'how readily does this model generate distress-shaped tokens' … not about distress

features.quote: State explicitly in the paper that the measure is distress-shaped text under failure conditions, and that the study is agnostic about whether this reflects any internal state.
features.justification_quote: lets you make the modest, defensible claim rather than the exciting, unsupported one
